In development. App availability, supported devices, translations and Premium purchasing await release verification.

Can I manage plant care on a Fire tablet?

FloraTend is being built as a native Android app with Fire tablets as its primary platform. The final supported device list will be based on actual release testing.

Designed for a tablet

Portrait, landscape and larger-screen layouts are part of the development brief. Seven-, eight- and ten-inch configurations require verification before compatibility is claimed.

No universal voice promise

Speech engines, camera capabilities and operating-system versions vary. A device-specific compatibility matrix will distinguish tested features from unverified ones.
